info.title: Munsha ERP — ASP.NET Core integration contract
info.summary: Complete v1 write contracts and screen-mapped collection, detail, lookup and report reads
info.description: English first-version ASP.NET Core integration contract. The repository contains a standalone React frontend, not an ASP.NET implementation. Existing frontend reads use composite /workspace, /auth/me and /backups calls. This documentation revision adds granular collection/detail/lookup/report GET contracts for those screens; these granular paths are PROPOSED and are NOT wired in the current frontend. All operations have summaries, descriptions and request/response examples. Success uses Result<T>; errors are top-level RFC 9457 Problem Details, with actual HTTP status codes. Existing command endpoints are retained to avoid silently changing write integration.

sessionCookie.description: Opaque local session cookie set by login. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure on HTTPS. Demo cookies do not authorize protected APIs.

ownerPlatformUserId.name: oai-authenticated-user-id
ownerPlatformUserId.description: Identity header injected only by the trusted hosting proxy, together with the owner email header. Not a public client API key; never trust user-supplied impersonation headers.

ownerPlatformEmail.name: oai-authenticated-user-email
ownerPlatformEmail.description: Owner email injected by the trusted hosting proxy. Must be combined with the user-ID header in the same security requirement; it is not an alternative standalone credential.

taxEnabled.description: Enable nonzero document tax. This does not implement jurisdiction-specific electronic tax filing.

taxRate.description: Tax percentage from 0 to 100; nonzero invoice tax requires accounting.taxEnabled.

get.summary: Get the compatibility workspace read projection
get.description: Return {state,revision} for the shared main workspace. All real roles can read the snapshot; no server-side field filtering or pagination is implemented. The first read may initialize seed data when the workspace is absent. Demo identity and accounts requiring password change are rejected with 401. Screens search and build reports from this loaded state. PROPOSED ONLY: implement the v1 route/adapter, success Result envelope and top-level RFC 9457 failures before calling it. Domain-rule failures use 422 in this contract. The granular read contracts in this revision are the intended read API for incremental frontend migration; they are not extra requests currently made by the frontend. This projection remains until that migration is complete.

get.description:
Return login users used by the associated directory/editor. Search name/code; currency searches code/name. Sort ascending by code/name then id. 

PROPOSED v1 READ CONTRACT: this granular endpoint is not implemented or called by the delivered frontend yet. Current screens derive their data from GET /workspace or /auth/me; implementing this route also requires frontend read-service integration. GET is side-effect-free: it never saves, posts, switches books, restores backups or creates seed records. Administrator role required. Never return password hashes, refresh tokens, cookies or session secrets. The data object contains items, pagination and scope. Empty results return HTTP 200 with items=[], totalItems=0, totalPages=0. Out-of-range pages return an empty items array. Sort by the documented stable business identifier with id as tie-breaker.

get.description:
Return branches used by the associated directory/editor. Search name/code; currency searches code/name. Sort ascending by code/name then id. 

PROPOSED v1 READ CONTRACT: this granular endpoint is not implemented or called by the delivered frontend yet. Current screens derive their data from GET /workspace or /auth/me; implementing this route also requires frontend read-service integration. GET is side-effect-free: it never saves, posts, switches books, restores backups or creates seed records. The server must authenticate the session and enforce organization/branch access; client filters are not authorization. The data object contains items, pagination and scope. Empty results return HTTP 200 with items=[], totalItems=0, totalPages=0. Out-of-range pages return an empty items array. Sort by the documented stable business identifier with id as tie-breaker.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based page number.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum rows per page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search over the documented name/code/reference fields. Trim leading/trailing spaces. Empty means no text filter.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter active/inactive master cards. Omit to include both.

parameters.name: bookId
parameters.description: Financial-book scope. Omit to use the current book. Closed books are read-only and must not be switched or modified by GET.

schema.description: Opaque persisted identifier. IDs are not necessarily UUIDs.
